title: Blackhole settings plugin configuration
description: Per-plugin (global) configuration for the blackhole-plugin. The pi-blackhole UnifiedConfig fields themselves live in the external ~/.pi/agent/pi-blackhole/pi-blackhole-config.json (edited via the settings form + the plugin's own routes), NOT in this dashboard config. See change: add-blackhole-plugin.

enabled.description: When false, the plugin is inactive (no settings section, no routes). Default-enabled; the settings page renders its own not-installed state when pi-blackhole is absent.
